parameters.content:
## 🛠️ START HERE — Template Setup Checklist
Before this workflow can run, replace these placeholders:

1. Job Scraper API Key credential (Apify) — the two Fetch Jobs nodes
2. Google Sheets credential + your own Sheet ID — Check Seen Job, Save Seen Job (Fit), Save Seen Job (No Fit). Create a sheet first with columns: jobUrl, jobId, title, company, matchScore, isGoodFit, postedToDiscord, seenAt, descriptionSummary
3. Perplexity API Key credential — Score With AI node
4. Discord webhook URL — Post to Discord node
5. Your resume text, target role titles, and pay range — Build Scoring Request node
6. Your Discord user ID (for @mentions) — Build Discord Embed node
7. Adjust the schedule (cron) and search keywords/locations to your own job search

This workflow starts INACTIVE on purpose. Do a manual test run once everything above is filled in, confirm a job posts correctly to Discord, then turn it on.

## 1) Schedule & Job Source
Job Search Trigger — cron 0 9,15,21 * * * (edit to your own run times, and set the node's timezone).

Compute Run Window treats one run (currently 9am) as the daily wide catch-up run — bigger date range, bigger job caps. If you move that run, update the runHour === 9 check here too.

Fetch Jobs — Location 1 / Location 2 (Apify): edit keywords to your target job titles, edit location for where to search. Add a 3rd location by duplicating one of these and wiring it into a 3rd Merge input.

## 2) Freshness Filter
Normalize Job Fields parses each posting's age and sets passesFreshnessFilter (wide window on the catch-up run, 1 hour + same-day otherwise).

Passes Filters? drops anything with no URL or that fails freshness — straight to the end, no Discord post, no sheet write.

## 3) Dedup Check (Google Sheets)
Check Seen Job reads your tracking sheet for this job's URL. Already Seen? skips it if a row was found, otherwise it moves on to AI scoring.

This is the SAME sheet the two Save Seen Job nodes write to. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID in all three Google Sheets nodes together if you move the sheet.

## 4) AI Scoring — main tuning spot
Build Scoring Request is where almost everything about "what counts as a good job" lives — clearly marked TEMPLATE blocks for: resumeText, roleFamilies, targetPayRange, plus the hard-exclusion rules and rubric weights written into the prompt, and the 65-point good-fit cutoff near the end.

Score With AI just sends that prompt to Perplexity (model: sonar). Parse AI Score unpacks the JSON response — no need to touch it unless the response shape changes.

## 5) Discord Post
Build Discord Embed builds the message: title, color (by score band), fields, the priority flag (posted within 1h AND score 80+ — edit isPriority to change), and the @mention via MENTION_MAP (name → your Discord user ID). Both are marked TEMPLATE — fill them in.

Post to Discord just POSTs that payload to a webhook URL — it's a required placeholder field, fill it in with your own channel's webhook before running.

## 6) Logging
Save Seen Job (Fit) and Save Seen Job (No Fit) both write to the same tracking sheet as the dedup check (Section 3), keyed on jobUrl. Every job gets logged — fit or not — which is what lets Already Seen? skip it next time.
